speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Under. You came in under it. Leave the top of it alone.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I know where it is. I can feel the board under the note.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And thou stayed on the board. That is the work.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I had my hand ready the first afternoon, Will. I did not need it today. He finished her himself.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I heard your hand, that first time. I was glad not to need it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Glad is a loud feeling. Keep it out of the last line. The last line is quieter than glad.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The last line was quiet. I put it where you put it in the mornings, and no higher.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Do not go looking for the old height because a yard is kind.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The yard was kind because the girl was true, not because they were counting his notes. Third time. They know the story. They come for the end.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Third time, and the mornings still stand. I am not cancelling a morning because an afternoon was brave.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I did not ask you to cancel it. I asked whether the court room is smaller.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Smaller, and nearer, and full of people who do not cough in the same places. Thou wilt speak lower there, not higher. A shout comes back off the panelling meaner than it went.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He's right. A presence is no place to prove a note. Prove the sense, lad, and let the note be the one thou canst keep.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The sense I have. The note I am borrowing from a lower stair. I can borrow it through Christmas.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then borrow it, and do not apologise to the stair. Tomorrow is not this. Tomorrow is the Master, and a chair, at nine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow thou bowest to the chair, and thou speakest as thou didst today. No experiment in front of him.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: No experiment. I heard you.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Third time, and I am still hungry. That is the only sum I trust before Saturday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Saturday is the fourth, if the bill holds. Do not spend it early.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I am not spending a Saturday in a Monday room. Nine of the clock tomorrow. If a chest is opened, we look before anyone wears what comes out of it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let them open it. I will not put a strange cloak on my back until I have had it in my hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow, then. Not tonight. Nick, eat. If thou art shaking, I want to know which part of thee it is.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The cold is in the hands. The note is in the mouth. Only the hands shook.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then warm the hands. I am done counting for today.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And we do not invent a cloak tonight to save ourselves a shiver at nine. Nine can look after itself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine can. We bow in what we stand up in, until someone with a chest says otherwise.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am going to Aldermanbury before my hands forget they are hands.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Go. Come in under, tomorrow, before he has sat down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Under, and no higher. I will see thee at nine.
